summary: Cowork repository installs must use the prebuilt host MCP at its standard installer location, while teammate prompts cover CLI installation, user-owned login and exact-account authorization.
reason: A repository skill alone cannot reach the host CLI from Cowork. Separate native marketplace entries avoid committing binaries or relying on GUI PATH, and explicitly scoped scheduled authorization avoids repeating confirmation without approving a different account.
validated_outcome: Isolated native Claude marketplace installation on Apple Silicon discovered the Mac skill and MCP session_check using temporary standard-location release binaries. Cowork repository UI, Windows runtime and unattended live inspection remain unverified. Fresh-project tests also invoke Skill with a retry-safe synthetic response and assert that full account/inspection instructions reach the model; natural model routing is not guaranteed.
